name: Honda CB300R / CB300F / CBR300R
intro: Honda's 300 single in three styles. Several recalls cover different years, so run the VIN.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2015 CB300F and CBR300R bikes are in recall 15V439 (starter relay). 2020-2021 CBR300Rs are in 21V382 (rear reflector). Some 2019 CB300Rs are in 19V412 (transmission circlip), and 2018-2025 CB300Rs are in 25V210 (headlight).

recalls.what: Starter relay switch can fail, so the bike may not start, or the starter may keep running.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the starter relay free.

recalls.what: Rear reflector lens may be too dim to meet the lighting standard.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear reflector free.

recalls.what: A transmission circlip can come off and misalign the gears.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the transmission main shaft free.

recalls.what: Headlight may flicker or shut off while riding.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the headlight assembly free.
